column2: t２１１／２／アペムンタ村壊滅報告

column3: \t\tかなみか誰かが情報を聞く
column4: \t\tKanami or someone else hears some information.

column3: \t\tさきほどいかなかったアペムンタ村は皆殺しになったと報告
column4: It is reported that Apemunta Village, which they hadn't gone to earlier, was completely massacred.

column3: \t\t本来、そんな村に無体な事は無意味なのに不思議な事だと
column4: Normally, it would be pointless to do such cruelty to a village like that; it's a strange matter.

column3: \t\t憎しみがあったように一人も逃がさず・・
column4: It was as if there was hatred, not letting a single person escape...

column3: \t\t他の村にはそういう事は無いです
column4: \t\tSuch things did not happen in other villages.
